title_ar: فضيلة الشيخ الددو يحاضر لجمعية الطفولة عن التماسك الأسري
title_en: Sheikh al-Dedew Lectures to the Childhood Association on Family Cohesion
body_ar: استضافت الجمعية الموريتانية لرعاية الطفولة مساء اليوم السبت 20 صفر 1433هـ الموافق: 14/01/2012 فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو حفظه الله في محاضرة هامة ألقاها تحت عنوان: "التماسك الأسري ودوره في تنشئة الجيل المنشود" وسط إقبال كثيف من طرف مئات أرباب الأسر والشباب والنساء والشيوخ والأطفال عصت بهم جوانب الجمعية والطرق المحاذية لها. وقد تحدث الشيخ في بداية محاضرته عن هذا الدين وتحقيقه لكل مصالح البشرية، معددا أقسام الدين حسب المخاطبين بدء بالفرد ثم الأسرة ثم المجتمع ثم السلطان، مبينا أهمية الأسرة ومحورية دورها في تكوين المجتمع، وقد أكد الشيخ على ضرورة إحسان كل من الزوجين على الآخر، منبها إلى المعايير التي أرشد إليها الشرع لاختيار طرفي العلاقة الزوجية، كما ذكر النيات الستة التي ينبغي لطالب النكاح الجمع بينها حتى يحثل أكبر قدر من الأجور. وخلال حديثه أشاد فضيلة الشيخ بضرورة تأسيس الأسرة على التقوى من أول يوم، وأهمية الحفاظ على صلاح الذرية؛ ضمانا لبقاء النسل، وحرصا على استمرار الحسنات للفرد حتى بعد مماته، وقد أكد الشيخ أن استمرار الأسرة مربوط بحرص الطرفين على هذا العقد الذي سماه الله "ميثاقا غليظا" وخلال المحاضرة ذكر الشيخ احتمالات الفراق التي تحصل بين الزوجين في الدنيا، ونبه لحكم الشرع في كل حالة. واعتبر فضيلة الشيخ أن سر استمرار العلاقة الزوجية اعتراف كل من الزوجين بالاختلاف بينهما في الطباع وغيرها، وضرورة استصحاب الصبر على ما لا يلائمه من الأفعال والأقوال. وقد سرد الشيخ عددا من المسائل التي تؤدي لاستمرار العلاقة بين الزوجين، مع سرد لمضار التفكك الأسري وآثاره الناتجة عنه، داعيا لتجنب مختلف المظاهر غير المحمودة للتفكك الاجتماعي، مختتما بسبل مواجهة التفكك الاجتماعي والحرص على استدامة حسن الخلق في التعامل بين الزوجين ووقوف كل منهما مع الآخر. وفي نهاية المحاضرة شكر فضيلة الشيخ حفظه الله مجهود الجمعية في تنشئة الأجيال تنشئة إسلامية صحيحة، والسعي لتميزهم التربوي والأخلاقي، داعيا الله التوفيق للقائمين على الجمعية. للمتابعة اضغط هنا:
body_en:
On the evening of Saturday 20 Safar 1433 AH, corresponding to 14/01/2012, the Mauritanian Association for the Care of Childhood hosted Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew, may God preserve him, for an important lecture which he delivered under the title "Family Cohesion and Its Role in Raising the Generation We Seek", amid a heavy turnout of hundreds of heads of households, young people, women, elders and children, who packed the association's precincts and the roads adjoining them.

At the beginning of his lecture the Sheikh spoke about this religion and how it secures every benefit of humankind, enumerating the divisions of the religion according to those addressed by it — beginning with the individual, then the family, then society, then the ruling authority — and explaining the importance of the family and the centrality of its role in the formation of society. The Sheikh stressed the necessity that each of the two spouses act well towards the other, drawing attention to the criteria to which the Sharia has directed us for choosing each party to the marital relationship, and he mentioned the six intentions that one seeking marriage (nikāḥ) ought to combine so as to obtain the greatest measure of reward.

In the course of his talk the Sheikh underlined the necessity of founding the family upon God-consciousness (taqwā) from the first day, and the importance of safeguarding the righteousness of one's offspring — as a guarantee of the continuance of the line, and out of concern that good deeds should continue to accrue to a person even after his death. The Sheikh affirmed that the endurance of the family is bound up with the care of both parties for this contract, which God has called "a solemn covenant". During the lecture the Sheikh mentioned the possible forms of separation that occur between spouses in this world, and drew attention to the ruling of the Sharia in each case.

The Sheikh held that the secret of the endurance of the marital relationship is that each of the two spouses acknowledge the difference between them in temperament and in other things, and the necessity of maintaining patience with whatever of the other's deeds and words does not suit him. The Sheikh set out a number of matters that lead to the endurance of the relationship between the spouses, together with an account of the harms of family breakdown and the effects that follow from it, calling for the avoidance of the various unpraiseworthy manifestations of social disintegration, and closing with the means of confronting social disintegration, the maintenance of good character in the dealings between the spouses, and the standing of each of them by the other.

At the end of the lecture the Sheikh, may God preserve him, thanked the association for its effort in raising generations upon a sound Islamic upbringing and in striving for their educational and moral excellence, and asked God to grant success to those who run the association.

flags.context: وسط إقبال كثيف من طرف مئات أرباب الأسر ... عصت بهم جوانب الجمعية والطرق المحاذية لها
options: read as غصت بهم — 'were packed with them' (the sense the sentence requires)
read عصت literally — 'disobeyed them', which yields no sense here
flags.note: Almost certainly a source typo: غصت (to be packed, crowded) written with ع. Style guide section 11 forbids silently fixing the source, so the Arabic is preserved as served and the English renders the only sense the sentence admits. Recorded so the Sheikh's office can correct the Arabic centrally.

flags.arabic: حتى يحثل أكبر قدر من الأجور
flags.context: النيات الستة التي ينبغي لطالب النكاح الجمع بينها حتى يحثل أكبر قدر من الأجور
options: read as يحصّل — 'so as to obtain'
flags.note: Second apparent typo in the same record: يحثل for يحصّل. Preserved in body_ar, rendered on the obvious reading in body_en, flagged rather than fixed.

flags.arabic: النيات الستة التي ينبغي لطالب النكاح الجمع بينها
flags.context: the six intentions in marriage, named but not listed
options: render exactly, leaving the six unlisted as the source does
supply the six from the Sheikh's other teaching
flags.note: The report names a six-part scheme and gives none of its parts. The same is true of 'the possible forms of separation' and 'the ruling of the Sharia in each case' further down: the news desk says a ruling was given and does not say what it was. Nothing may be supplied. This record is a third-party news summary of a lecture, not the Sheikh's own text, and must not be displayed as though its contents were his wording.

flags.context: هذا العقد الذي سماه الله "ميثاقا غليظا"
flags.note: A Qur'anic phrase quoted inside a news report without a reference. The source gives it in ordinary quotation marks rather than as a citation, so the English keeps the quotation marks rather than the curly-brace convention of style guide section 4; the reference is Sūrat al-Nisāʾ 4:21. Qur'anic renderings in this corpus are interpretive and are not a substitute for the Arabic.

translator_notes: This is a news report written by the site's news desk about a lecture, not a text by the Sheikh. Everything attributed to him arrives at second hand and in summary. The site must render it as reportage.

The CMS timestamp, 14 January 2012, is a bulk-upload date and is not evidence of when the lecture was given; the body itself dates the lecture to the evening of Saturday 20 Safar 1433 / 14 January 2012.
'أرباب الأسر' is rendered 'heads of households' rather than 'fathers': the Arabic is not gendered and the audience is said to have included women.
